title: Nargisi Kofta

ingredients.title: For the Kofta
items: Minced lamb or beef – 500 g, lean

ingredients.title: For the Gravy
items: Fresh cream or whisked yogurt – 200 ml
Saffron soaked in warm milk – a pinch (optional)

instruction.title: Prepare the Eggs
steps: Boil the eggs for 8–10 minutes until hard-boiled.
Cool, peel, and set aside.
Slice a very thin layer from the bottom of each egg if desired so they can sit flat when serving.

instruction.title: Prepare the Kofta Mixture
steps: In a mixing bowl, combine minced meat, grated onion, ginger-garlic paste, green chilies, red chili powder, turmeric, garam masala, coriander, and salt.
Knead the mixture thoroughly for 3–4 minutes until it becomes cohesive.
Add besan if the mixture feels too soft to wrap around the eggs.

instruction.title: Shape the Nargisi Kofta
steps: Divide the meat mixture into 4 equal portions.
Flatten one portion in your palm into an even layer.
Place a boiled egg in the center.
Carefully wrap the meat completely around the egg, sealing all edges.
Repeat with the remaining eggs and meat mixture, ensuring there are no gaps.

instruction.title: Fry the Kofta
steps: Heat oil in a deep, heavy-bottomed pan over medium heat.
Shallow fry the koftas, turning gently, until golden brown on all sides and cooked through.
Remove and drain on paper towels.

instruction.title: Prepare the Gravy
steps: Heat oil or ghee in a pan over medium heat.
Add cumin seeds and let them sizzle.
Add sliced onions and sauté until golden brown.
Add ginger-garlic paste and cook until the raw aroma disappears.
Add tomato puree, coriander powder, turmeric, and red chili powder.
Cook until the tomato mixture thickens and the oil begins to separate.
Add water or stock and bring the gravy to a gentle simmer.
Lower the heat and slowly add cream or whisked yogurt while stirring continuously to prevent curdling.
Add garam masala and adjust the salt.

instruction.title: Simmer the Koftas
steps: Gently place the fried koftas into the simmering gravy.
Cover and cook on low heat for 8–10 minutes so the koftas absorb the flavors.
If using saffron, add the warm saffron milk during the final few minutes.

instruction.title: Garnish & Serve
steps: Garnish with freshly chopped coriander leaves.
Slice the koftas in half to reveal the egg center.
Serve hot with naan, roti, or steamed basmati rice.

chefTips: Meat: Use fresh, lean minced meat for a soft but firm kofta coating.
Binding: Knead the meat mixture thoroughly so it becomes sticky and adheres securely around the eggs.
Sealing: Wrap each egg completely with an even layer of meat and eliminate any gaps to prevent splitting during frying.
Gravy: Keep the heat low when adding cream or yogurt; high heat can cause the dairy to split.
Presentation: Slice the koftas in half just before serving to showcase the distinctive egg center.
Luxury finish: A small pinch of saffron infused in warm milk adds a refined aroma and color to the gravy.
